rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=60, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.0, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=800, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-8 REDO (breast ItNet v1). Prior iter-8 (train_n800, ep120) TIMED OUT at 30:15 (2x data at full epochs overran even turbo). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-5 (train_n400,ep120,c16,k1,a0.0,lr1e-3) hr 0.8741 CHAMPION (400x120=48000 grad steps). iter-6 lr dead; iter-7 c24+epcut 0.8584. (2) FAILURE MODE: is the denoiser DATA-limited (400 scenes) or COMPUTE-limited? Disentangle by holding total gradient steps CONSTANT while doubling scene DIVERSITY. (3) ONE KNOB (data-diversity, compute-matched): train_n 400 -> 800 with pretrain_epochs 120 -> 60 so 800x60 = 48000 grad steps = EXACTLY iter-5s budget (the epoch cut is pure compute-normalization, not an independent hypothesis). All else = champion iter-5. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I show the denoiser 2x MORE distinct scenes at the SAME total compute, I expect hr above 0.8741 because 400 scenes likely under-cover the breast-phantom distribution and more diversity reduces val overfit at equal training cost. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.8741, the denoiser was NOT data-diversity-limited at 400 scenes -> the ceiling is model CAPACITY -> iter-9 tests unet_c at compute-matched epochs (width up, epochs down to hold steps). (5) BUDGET: 48000 grad steps = iter-5s ~1189s train portion; +turbo -> comfortably < 20 min. train_n=800 <= 2400 FBP-safe. (6) Loop to iter-20.
